verdict.rationale: Bento says every prompt, skill, and model change is versioned, diffable, and reversible (docs-15). It also describes Bento-generated nudges and skills that ship in shadow mode and graduate to full production traffic (docs-11, docs-12), which implies some runtime rollout outside a code deploy. However, skills and rules live in your repo as Markdown/YAML (docs-16), and nothing documents a prompt registry or a way to edit and publish your own prompts without a code release. missing for 10: documented developer-facing prompt registry/editor, explicit no-code-deploy prompt publishing or fetching at runtime, environment/label promotion for prompts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
